Dear Madam [Sir](/person/1477)
Pray excuse the mistake Certainly Jeannie is a mere caressing form of Jean, just as Annie is of Anne.

Both are only the Scottish form of Johanna, Jane or Joan

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: With envelope addressed to The Revd M G Watkins/ Kentchurch Rectory/Hereford and postmarked Winchester 15 January 1891 and Pontrilas 16 January 1891.
